LESSON: TRIGONOMETRY 1

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: CORE MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurements and Geometry
Topic 2.4: Trigonometry 1
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 15

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Trigonometry 1, part of Measurements and Geometry in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 CORE MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we use trigonometry in real-life situations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work with peers to identify from the immediate environment shapes that make right- angled triangles. Learners with speech difficulties could use augmentative and alternative communication-AAC. Those with mobility difficulties could be supported by peers/ learner support assistant or teacher,

2. draw right-angled triangles and use them to define and work out sine, cosine, and tangent ratios. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use appropriate assistive

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work with peers to identify from the immediate environment shapes that make right- angled triangles. Learners with speech difficulties could use augmentative and alternative communication-AAC. Those with mobility difficulties could be supported by peers/ learner support assistant or teacher,
2. draw right-angled triangles and use them to define and work out sine, cosine, and tangent ratios. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use appropriate assistive

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Trigonometry 1 together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and Imagination: as the learner makes a simple clinometer using locally available material and uses it as

a learning resource.

● Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving: as the learner discusses and makes observations about the sine and cosine

of complementary angles, and applies trigonometric ratios in the solution of triangles.

● Digital literacy: as the learner uses digital devices and other resources such as books, manuals, and journals to

learn more about trigonometric ratios.

Values:
● Responsibility: as the learner takes care of mathematical tables and calculators used in determining trigonometric

ratios.

● Unity: as the learner works in a group for instance when using an isosceles right-angled triangle and an equilateral

triangle to generate the trigonometric ratios of special angles 30o

, 45o

, 60o, and 90o

40

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Environmental Education and Protection: as the learner identifies shapes in the immediate environment that have

right-angled triangles, and makes a simple clinometer using materials from the immediate environment.

● Parental Engagement and Empowerment: as the learner gets support from parents/guardians to get resources to

make a clinometer.

Suggested Learning Resources

Geometrical instruments (padded compass/ dividers, rulers with enhanced grip, protractor with handle), metre rule

with handle, mathematical tables, charts on multiplication tables/ trigonometric ratios, drawing/ manila/ graph papers,

scissors with enhanced grip, multipurpose communication boards on right angled triangles, white boards, slant boards,

book holders, head pointers, page turners, pen/pencil holders, adapted scientific calculators/ projectors, adhesives,

positioning devices such as special seats with straps, adapted digital devices such as adapted computers with larger

screens
